tei:div.tei:p: (81)snyan brgyud phur pa'i smad las dug phur nag po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ (82)

badz+ra ku mā ra la na mo/ snyan brgyud phur pa'i smad las dug phur nag po dang 'brel ba'i rjes rim tshogs kyi mchod pa ni/ 'byor ldan po byad kyi tshogs bzang zhing gya nor phud ma nyams par bshams te/ oṃ badz+ra amṛ ta kun+dha lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bdag la gtor bas ting 'jin mi gsal ba dang cho ga la ma tshang ba yod pa bsang*/ yang amṛ ta sa gtor bas tshogs rdzas kyi ma dag (83) pa dag par bsam mo/ de nas sbyang ba ni/ hūm̐/ snod kyi thod pa stong gsum khyon/ bcud kyi tshogs rdzas byur bus gtams/ ram̐ las me 'bar dngos 'jin bsregs/ yam̐ las rlung byung bag chags gtor/ kham̐ las chu byung gnyis 'jin bkrus/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ bdag nyid dpal gyi thugs ka nas/ yi ge 'bru gsum (84)char du bab/ oṃ gyis shel ltar dwangs pa la/ āḥyis bdud rtsi dmar mer gyur/ hūm̐ gis sngo bsang mkha' ltar dag de nyid rnam gsum 'dres pa'i steng*/ ma las nyi ma rab gsal ba/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā rnams las/ skyes pa'i rigs kyi yab lnga dang*/ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ rnams las/ dbyings phyug yum dang bcas pa rnams/ mnyam par sbyor ba'i 'phro 'du las/ thig le byang chub sems su zhu/ spris ma (85)oṃ du chags pa las/ 'dod yon lnga yi lha mo 'phro/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā sarba pañtsa amṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥ spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐/ srid pa phur bur sgrub pa dang*/ dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir/ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu dang*/ yum mchog 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma/ sras dang sprul pa khra thabs bcas/ bka' nyan dam can srung ma'i tshogs/ rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang*/ kī la ya yi dngos grub phyir (86)longs spyod tshogs la gshegs su gsol/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya jaḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ de nas tshogs phud ni/ hūm̐/ bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang*/ gnas gsum ma mo mkha' 'gro dang*/

dpa' bo dpa' mor bcas pa rnams/ kun bzang mchod sprin rol par mjod/ bdag gis g.yo med gus ldan pas/ rnal 'byor gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ snang srid chos dang rgyal srid bdun/ phyag rgya bzhi dang nyon (87)mongs lnga/ ting 'jin mchod pa bdud rtsi lnga/ 'dod yon lha mo glu dang gar/ rtog med don gyi mchod pa 'bul/ pho brang bzhugs gnas zhing khams su/ mchod pa'i sprin gyis gtibs shing rgyas/ snang srid mchod par bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ye shes rol pa'i zhal chen por/ snod bcud ma lus mchod par sbyor/ dbyings ye rol pa'i mchod pa ru/ khams gsum thams cad mchod par 'bul/ de nas kun tu dbye ba med pa'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ rgyal ba (88)ma lus zhi khro'i sku/ dwangs snyigs mi byed mnyam pa'i ngang*/ dug gsum skyon bral dbyings kyis mchod/ 'du 'bral med pa'i mchod par rol/ de nas thams cad mnyam pa nyid du mchod pa ni/ nga dang bdag med mkha' ltar dag ye shes lhun gyis grub pa las/ gnyis med bde chen mnyam pas mchod/ mnyam nyid blang dor med par rol/ de nas 'dod yon gyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ byang chub rol pa longs spyod sprul pa'i sku/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lha mo'i mchod pa 'di/ snang srid ma lus 'dod (89)dgur bsgyur byas te/ mkha' ltar dag pa'i dbyigs su ye shes rol/ ma hā ga ṇa tsakra khā hi/ ma hā ja gad la khā hi/ ma hā pañtsa amṛ ta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā māṃ sa khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta khā hi/ ma hā koṃ ni ri ti khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi/ ma hā sarba pū ja hoḥ de nas bar bshags ni/ hūm̐/ ye shes lha la rnam rtog mi mnga' yang*/ de yi 'khor du gtogs pa'i dam (90)can rnams/ mi yi skyon mthong tsam nas bar chad rtsom/ 'gal 'khrul nongs pa ci mchis mthol lo bshags/ bzod par bzhes nas tshangs par stsal du gsol/ ces yi ge brgya pa brjod/ tha ma bsgral ba ni/

mdun du e las gnam lcags kyi brug khung phyi nag la nang lcags bsregs dmar zang nge ba kha yangs pa gting zab pa phyi na zhe sdang gi me 'bar ba/ nang na ti mug gi mun pa gtibs pa/ log pa la nga rgyal gyi mtshon cha gzing ba/ (91)gting na 'dod chags kyi khrag mtsho dmar nag tu 'khrugs pa/ phyogs kun tu phrag dog gi rlung dmar 'tshubs pa'i nang du nyams pa can dngos su gsal te/ las byed spru pa'i pho nya mang po 'gugs sgrol gyi shan pa gsod gcod kyi las la rngams shing 'khrugs nas nyi zer gyi rdul 'tshubs pa bzhin g.yo bar mos te/ dang po rig 'jin rnams bskul te/ hūm̐/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing*/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung (92)'tshob pa'i/ rig 'jin rnams kyi dus la bab/ phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ rgya gar tsan+da nags tshal du/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyen lam 'tshal/ phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig paṇa chen bi ma mi tra yis/ rgya gar chu bo gaṅgā la/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyen lam 'tshal/ phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig bal po shrī la mañdzu yis/ maṇ+ḍal la yi mkhar gong (93)du/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyen lam 'tshal/ phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis/ srog bdag sprul pa spyang ku la/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyen lam 'tshal/ phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig gzungs ma a tsar+ya sa le yi/ nyon mongs skye shi'i chu bo la/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyen lam 'tshal/ phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig rig 'jin pad+ma las (94) 'brel gyis/ dam sri 'tshubs pa'i dmag dpung la/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyen lam 'tshal/ phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig zhes nye brgyud ltar ram/ yang na ring brgyud ltar na/ mchims ston shākya pra bha yis/ yar lung gad kyi brag phug tu/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyen lam 'tshal/

phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig shud pu dpal gyi seṅge yis/ 'u shang rdo yi brag log la/ mdo yi zhes snang dpyad mchan/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyen lam 'tshal/ phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig sna nam rdo rje bdud (95)'joms kyis/ has po ri yi yang gong du/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyen lam 'tshal/ phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig mkhar chen dpal gyi dbang phyug gis/ rtsibs kyi spyang ku sngon po la/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyen lam 'tshal/ phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig me yang snang mchan me nub rgyal ba'i snying po yis/ bdud kyi sprul pa'i bya rog la/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyen lam 'tshal/ phur bu sgrub pa'i (96)grogs mjod cig lo tsā dpal gyi blo grogs kyis/ mon dmag mang po cham la phab/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyen lama'atshal/ phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig ngam 'bro klu yi rgyal mtshan gyis/ dgra la btab pas bgegs kyang bsgral/ ja ltar rtags bstan bsnyen lam 'tshal/ phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig ngam 'bre sa le dbang phyug gis/ 'od la btab pas dkor bdag bsgral/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyen (97)lam 'tshal/ phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig lang lab byang chub rdo rje yis/ rkun ma'i rjes btab nor rnams khug ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyen lam 'tshal/ phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig sna nam shes rab tshul khrims kyis/ mthu chen stag ram mi dgu bsgral/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyen lam 'tshal/ phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig skyi nag byang chub rin chen gyis/ (98)gyang la btab pas sku dgra bsgral/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyen lam 'tshal/ phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig nyang nag dbang gi shes rab kyis/ dgra bgegs ma lus cham la phab/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyen lam 'tshal/ phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig de sras shākya rgyal mtshan gyis/

'dir nag rta pa mi dgu bsgral/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyen lam 'tshal/ phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig slob dpon drag po (99)chen po yis/ sku dgra ban+de bcu gsum bsgral/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyen lam 'tshal/ phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig se ston khro rgyal rdo rje yis/ khri rgyal zhes snang dpyad/ dgra bgegs gnyis po dus gcig bsgral/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyen lam 'tshal/ phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig slob ma lha rje phur ston gyis/ dgra bgegs gnyis la phur pas thebs/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyen lam 'tshal/ (100)phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig rgya ston nam mkha' rgyal po yis/ dgra bgegs gnyis la phur pas thebs/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyen lam 'tshal/ phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig de'i sras nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis/ dgra bgegs gnyis phyer mar byas/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyen lam 'tshal/ phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig nyang ban shu mangs lung pa yis/ gdug pa'i dgra bgegs phur pas bsgral/ (101)ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyen lam 'tshal/ phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig sngags 'chang nag po maṇ+ḍi tas/ zhing bcu thams cad gtanal phab/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyen lam 'tshal/ phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig slob dpon chu bar nyang phug pas/ nye phug ces kyang mthong dpyad/ bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin dngos grub brnyes/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyen lam 'tshal/ phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig ban (102)grogs gsang sngags rdo rje yis/ thun gtor me 'bar dgra bgegs bsgral/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyen lam 'tshal/ phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig u rgyan rdo rje seṅge yis/ phur pa 'phar zhing bzhad par bsgrubs/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyen lam 'tshal/ phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig rig 'jin pad+ma las 'brel gyis/ dam sri 'tshubs pa'i dmag dpung la/

ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyen lam 'tshal/ (103)phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig phur pa'i brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams/ rang rang so so'i sgrub khang nas/ ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyen lam 'tshal/ phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mjod cig khyed rnams phrin las dus la babs/ rtags mtshan ston pa'i dus la babs/ mthu rtsal phyung ba'i dus la babs/ kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol/ de nas 'gugs pa'i phyir thugs dam bskul zhing*/ pho nya btang ba ni/ hūm̐/ srid pa'i phur bur sgrub pa dang*/ (104)dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir/ ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol/ ye shes khro bo gshegs nas kyang*/ rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang*/ kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i thugs dam bskul/ sprul pa chen po'i dus la babs/ khro bcu yab yum thugs dam bskul/ phyag brnyan chen mo'i dus la babs/ khra thabs nyi shu'i thugs dam bskul/ shwa na mu kha'i dus la babs/ bdag nyid (105)chen mo'i dus la babs/ sa bdag chen mo'i dus la babs/ khyed kyi phrin las dus la babs/ mthu rtsal phyung ba'i dus la babs/ ces lha tshogs bskul nas/ de nas gzugs la dbab cing dgug pa la drug las/ dang po lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu rnams thogs te/ hūm̐/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing*/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i/ rig 'jin bdag cag rnams la ni/ gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ bdud dang bar du (106)gcod pa rnams/ khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ yud tsam gyis ni 'dir khug la/ mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral ba dang*/ lus nga rdul du bshigs nas kyang*/ sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mjod/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la yang*/ jaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ ka taṃ ka ye/ ja ye bi ja ye/ a tsi te a pa ra tsi te/ ma ra se na pra mar ta na ye/ dgra bgegs sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dgra bgegs kyi bla khug phar bzlas nas/

de nas gnyis pa lha dang phral ba ni gu gul gyis bdug la/ hūm̐/ (107)dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ mthu rtsal phyung ba'i dus la bab/ dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ gtogs shig grogs dang bral bar gyis/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ jaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ ka taṃ ka ye/ ja ye bi ja ye/ a tsi te a pa ra tsi te/ ma ra se na pra mar ta na ye/ ha sa ya ra ha sa ya ra hrīḥdaṇ+ḍa hūm̐ phaṭa/ dbye ba'i rdzas bdug go gsum pa gzugs la dbab pa ni yungs kar thogs la/ (108)hūm̐/ sprul pa chen po'i dus la bab/ mthu rtsal phyung ba'i dus la bab/ dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ gtogs shig grogs dang bral bar gyis/ phob cig rnam par gzir bar gyis/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ jaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ ka taṃ ka ye/ ja ye bi ja ye/ a tsi te a pa ra tsi te/ ma ra se na pra mar ta na ye/ a be sha ya a be sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ bzhi pa byang du gzhug pa ni byad thag thogs la bcing ste/ hūm̐/ (109)phyag brnyan chen mo'i dus la bab/ mthu rtsal phyung ba'i dus la bab/ dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ zung zhig rgyob cig rnam par chings/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ jaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ ka taṃ ka ye/ ja ye bi ja ye/ a tsi te a pa ra tsi te/ ma ra se na pra mar ta na ye/ shri gh+raṃ a na ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ lnga pa smyor gzhag pa ni dug thun thogs la/ hūm̐/ shwa na mu kha'i dus la bab/ (110)mthu rtsal phyung ba'i dus la bab/ dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ rings par khug la smrar chug cig oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ jaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ ka taṃ ka ye/ ja ye bija ye/ a tsi ta a pa ra tsi te/ ma ra se na pra mar ta na ye/ dz+wa la sa ya dz+wa la sa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ drug pa phung po rdul du bshigs pa la tho bas brdung ba ni/ tho ba thogs te/

hūm̐/ sa bdag chen mo'i dus la bab/ mthu rtsal phyung ba'i dus la bab/ (111)dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du bshigs/ oṃ badz+ra kī la kī la ya/ jaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ ka taṃ ka ye/ ja ye bi ja ye/ a tsi te a pa ra tsi te/ ma ra so na pra mar ta na ye ta thā ya ta thā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ mi bzad pa'i phur pa drug btab pa la/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid chen mo'i dus la bab/ mthu rtsal phyung ba'i dus la bab/ dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs/ gdug cing sdang (112)sems ldan pa rnams/ nga yi dbang du gyur nas ni/ bsgo ba'i bka' la nyan par gyis/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ jaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ ka taṃ ka ye/ ja ye bi ja ye/ a tsi ta a pa ra tsi te/ ma ra se na pra mar ta na ye/ bhin+dha ya bhin+dha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ dam can gyis phur pa thogs te/ hūm̐/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ sprul pa chen po'i dus la bab/ phyag brnyan chen mo'i dus la bab/ shwa na mu kha'i dus la bab/ sa bdag bswe mo'i dus la bab/ bdag nyid chen (113)mo'i dus la bab/ khyed kyi dam tshig dus la bab/ lus ngag rdul du bshigs nas kyang*/ sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mjod/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sa ra bi t+yan hūm̐ phaṭa/ che ge mo sarba bigh+nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ts+tshin+dha ts+tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ bhin+dha bhin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ghṛ h+ṇa ghṛ h+ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/

de nas thun dbab pa ni/ khro bcu'i phur pa btab nas/ hūm̐/ rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' las ni/ sdig can gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ (114)stobs chen khro bo chen po yis/ klad pa tshal pa brgyu ru khos/ nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs/ nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byad/ hūm̐ ma ma sa shaṃ ku ru ma ti ny+ya ka ra i nan dha ti ma ma shī gh+raṃ ka ra ye sarba bigh+nan bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐/ garja garja hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha bi ja ya hūm̐/ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kro dha ni la dan+ḍa hūm̐/ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya mān+ta ka hūm̐/ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra (115)kro dha ār+ya a tsa la hūm̐/ bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya grī wa hūm̐/ hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a pa ra tsit+ta hūm̐/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐/ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha tre lo kya bi ja ya hūm̐/ bhin+dha bhin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la hūm̐/ s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces khro bcu'i sngags kyi thun brab po/ de nas sras phur snying dkar nan mtshams su btab ste/ hūm̐/ srid pa'i phur bu sgrub pa dang*/ dbang dang dngos (116)grub blang ba'i phyir/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ sprul pa chen po'i dus la bab/ phyag brnyan chen mo'i dus la bab/ shwa na mu kha'i dus la bab/ sa bdag chen mo'i dus la bab/ khyed kyi dam tshig dus la bab/ mthu rtsal phyung ba'i dus la bab/ khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral ba dang*/ lus ngag rdul du bshigs nas kyang*/ sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mjod/ bzhi snying dang (117) spu gri'i sngags kyis bsgral te/ de nas gtun du brdung te/ hūm̐/ brdung shing rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun/ bka' las 'da' byed sdig can rnams/

rdo rje me dbal snying bsregs nas/ lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du rlog khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung du/ rdo rje tho bas brdung byas nas/ lha yang rung ste brlag par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya jaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ che ge mo mā ra ya/ ta thā ya ta thā ya/ shī gh+raṃ ka ra ye/ ma ra se na pra marta na ye sarba bigh+nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ kha thaṃ (118)kha taṃ kha thaṃ/ zhes nyer gcig bzlas te/ tshogs la bstabs pa ni/ hūm̐/ khrag 'thung chen po 'khor bcas kyis/ 'bar ba chen po'i zhal hom du/ bstan pa 'jig pa'i dgra bgegs rnams/ ngas bstabs khyed kyi yul la rol/ shin tu gdug cing gtum pa rnams/ lhag ma med par bzhes nas kyang*/ dgra bgegs bag chags kun byang shog oṃ badz+ra kī la kī la ya jaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bhin+dha ya bhin+dha ya sarba bighān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ badz+ra (119)yak+sha kro dha khā hi khā hi/ ha ha ha/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ chos nyid kyi bden pa'o/ gsang sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs po/ sangs rgyas kyi mthu'o/ a bhi tsar+ya'i dus la bab pa'o/ badz+ra kī li kī la ya nyer gcig bzla'o/ bsnag pa de kho na la'o/ badz+ra kī li kī la ya lan gtso brgyad bzla'o/ dkar nag gi mtshams su'o/ kī la ya lan bdun bzla'o/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes bzla'o/ ༈ de nas las kyi mtha' mnan pa byed par 'dod na/ brub khung (120) nang du liṅga spyi'am dgra sri g.yag mgo sogs gang 'dod sbyar te/ hūm̐/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing*/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdug 'tshob pa'i/ rig 'jin bdag cag rnams la ni/ gnod cing gdug pa'i che ge dgra bgegs zhes snang dgra pri sogs 'di/ stobs chen khro bo 'khor bcas kyis/ byang chub sems ni ma skyes par/ nam yang btang bar mi bya'o/ bzhi snying dang*/ oṃ laṃ/ āḥlaṃ/ hūm̐ laṃ/ s+t+waṃ bha ya che ge mā ra ya nan/ zhes bzlas/ de nas dug gtor steng du blugs te/

dz+wa la tsakra oṃ bh+rūm̐/ dz+wa la tsakra hūm̐ bh+rūm̐/ (121)dz+wa la tsakra trām̐ bh+rūm̐/ dz+wa la tsakra hrīḥbh+rūm̐/ dz+wa la tsakra hā bh+rūm̐/ zhes mtshon cha'i char dbab par bsam mo/ de nas g.yam par rdo rje rgya gram bris pas kha bcad/ yang*/ oṃ laṃ sogs kyi ri rab kyis mnan par bsam/ de nas rtsa sngags brjod de de'i steng du skad cig gis lha rnams bskyed la lha'i pho brang btab par bsam mo/ rjes su mi shis pa'i gnas su phyin la/ lha 'dre la gser skyems btang*/ bden pa brdar/ gzu dpung gzug de nas dong gru gsum du brus par thod ngan nang du liṅga rtsal la dong du sba'o/ ༈ de nas zlog pa'i phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūm̐/ phur pa rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ mthing nag (122)e yi gzhal yas khang*/ lha chen nyi zla pad+ma'i steng*/ che mchog rdau rje gzhon nu che/ dpal chachen yak+sha he ru ka ye shes sku mchog rigs kun bdag hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sgra chen sgrogs/ mi dmigs spros bral thugs dang ldan/ dbyings las byin rlabs khro bcur sprul/ chos dbyings mi 'gyur sku mdog mthing*/ 'jigs pa'i dur khrod dpal chas rdzogs/ g.yas dkar chos sku mngon sum ston/ g.yon dmar dbang drag phrin las mjad/ phrin (123)las thams cad lhun gyis grub/ skye shi rtsad gcod mche ba gtsigs spyan dgu 'bar bas bdud dpung 'joms/ nyon mongs log lta mtha' dag 'dul/ gar dgu'i nyams kyis 'jigs mjad cing*/ rdo rje rtse dgus rtog pa 'joms/ rtse lngas rgyud lnga gnas su 'joms/ me dpung 'khor ba'i bag chags bsregs/ kha ṭ+wām̐ bdud bzhi thal bar brlag ri rab phur pa 'gal byed sgrol/ che btsan dpe med 'gran zla bral/ ye (124)shes rtsal shugs stobs dang ldan/ sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la/ ban bon rbod gtong sbyor ba yis/ gtad du bcug na gtad sprug cig byad du bug na byad thag gcod/ thun du bcug na thun khang shig

khram la btab na khram kha bzlog byad kha chom la byad ma song*/ byad thag chod la byad rgya shig byad kyi tha ram bkrol du gsol/ dus min 'chi rkyen ngan pa zlog byad ma rang gshed rang la phob/ (125)byad ma'i rang byad rang la bskor/ byad ma'i rang mthu rang la zlog zlalog cig bsgyur cig mthu ma chung*/ bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mjod/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya jaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ka taṃ ka ye/ ja ye bi ja ye/ a tsi te a pa ra tsi te/ ma ra se na pra marta na ye dgra bgegs sarba bigh+nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ e sa bh+yo zlog hūm̐/ gnyis med sbyor ba'i yum mchog ni/ 'khor ba ye shes rgyas 'debs ma/ sgrol yum e ka (126)dzā ṭi gnyis/ pad+ma gar gyi mkha' klong na/ bai ḍūr sngon po'i sku mdog 'tsher/ mthing gi ral pa gcig tu 'khyil/ khro gnyer rngam pa'i mche ba gtsigs/ me lce 'od kyi phreng bas brgyan/ sha rus gsol ba'i rkan sgra can/ mi mgo'i phreng ba sbrul chun 'phyang*/ zhing chen g.yang gzhis stod g.yogs shing*/ gzig gi spags pa'i sham thabs can/ khrag 'jag thod rlon shin tu mjes/ khrag mtsho 'dren pa'i ljags rlobs ma/ 'khor (127)lo rtse gsum g.yas thogs/ thod rlon klad khrag 'dres pa g.yon/ gzir mnan drag po dpal gyi yum/ thams cad dbang sdud sring gcig ma/ me bza' ma la brag byon ma/ srid gsum phung byed mthu mo che/ sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sogs/ bzhi snying dang*/ e sa bh+yo zlog hūm̐/ steng nas khro rgyal hūm̐ kā ra/ zhal gsum phyag drug 'jigs pa'i sku/ zhabs bzhis tshangs pa pho mo gnon/ ri rab phur pas spyi nas gnon/ sgra 'byin yum dang gnyis su med/ phyogs bcur mgyogs pa'i pho nya 'gyed/ rnam rtog mi mnga' phag mgo can/ g.yas g.yon rdo rje phur pa 'dril/ rmig bu'i mgo can dril bu thogs/ ban dgra dam nyams glang snying 'di/ khug cig phob cig yan lag chings/ gzir cig khrag tu skyugs par mjod/

sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sogs 'gres so/ bzhi snying dang*/ e sa bh+yo zlog hūm̐/ shar nas khro chen rnam par rgyal/ zhal gsum phyag drug (129)'jigs pa'i sku/ zhabs bzhes lha dbang pho mo gnon/ ri rab phur pas dgra bgegs sgrol/ snyoms ma yum dang gnyis su med/ phyogs bcur mgyogs pa'i pho nya 'gyed/ phyag brnyan za byed stag gi mgo g.yas g.yon lcags kyu phur pa 'dril/ thogs med bya rgod rnga yab thobs/ byad ma dam nyams glang snying can/ khug cig phob cig yan lag chings/ gzir cig khrag tu skyugs par (130)mjod/ sha khrag gtor ma sogs 'gres so/ bzhi snying dang*/ e sa bh+yo zlog hūm̐/ shar lho khro rgyal dbang phyug sngon can/ dbu gsum phyag drug 'jigs pa'i sku/ zhabs bzhis drang srong pho mo gnon/ ri rab phur pas khams gsum sgrol/ sder mo yum dang gnyis su med/ pho nya mgyogs byed phyogs bcur 'gyed/ phyag brnyan g.yag gi mgo bo can/ g.yas g.yon dbang phyug te phur pa 'dril/ rig shes bya rog me dpung thogs/ byad ma dam nyams sogs 'gres so/ bzhi snying (131) dang*/ e sa bh+yo zlog hūm̐/ lho nas khro rgyal gshin rje gshed/ dbu gsum phyag drug 'jigs pa'i sku/ zhabs bzhis gshin rje pho mo gnon/ ri rab phur pas khams gsum sgrol/ dur khrod bdag mor gnyis su med/ sprul pa'i pho nya phyogs bcur 'gyed/ phyag brnyan sha ba'i mgo bo can/ g.yas g.yon dbyug pa phyur pa 'dril/ mun mthong 'ug mgos dgra s+t+wa thogs/ byad ma dam nyams sogs 'gres so/ bzhi (132) snying dang*/ e sa bh+yo zlog hūm̐/ lho nub khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon/ dbu gsum phyag drug 'jigs pa'i sku/ zhabs bzhis srin po pho mo gnon/ ri rab phur pas dgra bgegs sgrol/ gtun khung yum dang gnyis su med/ sprul pa'i pho nya phyogs bcur 'gyed/ phyag brnyan spyod rdzogs gzig gi mgo g.yas g.yon ral gri phur pa 'dril/

sbed byed khwa ta zhags pa thogs/ byad ma dam nyams sogs 'gres so/ bzhi snying dang*/ e sa bh+yo zlog hūm̐/ (133)nub nas khro rgyal rta mchog dpal/ dbu gsum phyag drug 'jigs pa'i sku/ zhabs bzhis klu dbang pho mo gnon/ ri rab phur pas khams gsum sgrol/ gtum mo yum dang gnyis su med/ sprul pa'i pho nya phyogs bcur 'gyed/ mkhas brtson byi la'i mgo bo can/ g.yas g.yon pad+ma phur pa 'dril/ gsal bkra su shud sbrul zhabs thogs/ byad ma dam nyams sogs 'gres so/ bzhi snying dang*/ e sa bh+yo zlog (134)hūm̐/ nub byang khro rgyal 'dod pa'i rgyal/ dbu gsum phyag drug 'jigs pa'i sku/ zhabs bzhis rlung lha pho mo gnon/ ri rab phur pas khams gsum sgrol/ mda' snyems yum dang gnyis su med/ sprul pa'i pho nya phyogs bcur 'gyed/ za byed cher 'jigs ci spyang mgo g.yas g.yon rdo rje phur pa 'dril/ gsod byed khra mgo 'khor lo thogs/ byad ma dam nyams sogs 'gres so/ bzhi snying dang*/ e sa bh+yo zlog hūm̐/ byang nas khro rgyal (135)bdud rtsi 'khyil/ dbu gsum phyag drug 'jigs pa'i sku/ zhabs bzhis gnod sbyin pho mo gnon/ ri rab phur pas khams gsum sgrol/ rlung 'byin yum dang dbu med/ sprul pa'i pho nya phyogs bcur 'gyed/ 'joms byed rtsal 'chang seṅge'i mgo g.yas g.yon rgya gram phur pa 'dril/ sgrin gsal pha wang be con thogs/ byad ma dam nyams sogs 'gres so/ bzhi snying*/ e sa bh+yo zlog hūm̐/ byang shar khro chen (136)khams gsum rgyal/ dbu gsum phyag drug 'jigs pa'i sku/ zhabs bzhis dbang ldan pho mo gnon/ ri rab phur pas khams gsum sgrol/ gsod byed yum dang gnyis su med/ sprul pa'i pho nya phyogs bcur 'gyed/ phyag brnyan stobs ldan dred kyi mgo g.yas g.yon rdo rje phur pa 'dril/ gsod byed sre mong rtse gsum thogs/ byad ma dam nyams sogs 'gres so/ bzhi snying*/ e sa bh+yo zlog

hūm̐/ 'og phyogs khro rgyal stobs po che/ (137)dbu gsum phyag drug 'jigs pa'i sku/ zhabs bzhis bdag pho mo gnon/ ri rab phur pas khams gsum sgrol/ bskyed ma yum dang gnyis su med/ sprul pa'i pho nya phyogs bcur 'gyed/ phyag brnyan dom gyi mgo bo can/ g.yas g.yon tho ba phur pa 'dril/ byi ba'i mgo can gtun shing thogs/ byad ma dam nyams sogs 'gres so/ bzhi snying*/ e sa bh+yo zlog hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgo bzhi nas/ phrin (138)las bzhi sgrub sgo ma bzhi/ ban dgra dam nyams glang snying rnams/ lcags kyus zung la zhags pas chings/ lcags sgrog sdom la dril bus myos/ ye shes las byed sgo ma bzhi/ sha khrag gtor ma sogs 'gres so/ bzhi snying dang*/ e sa bh+yo zlog hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor phyi rim bar khyams su/ thugs rje shugs kyis 'du ba yi/ slas dang byi mo bran mo'i tshul/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad/ sha khrag gtor ma sogs 'gres so/ bzhi snying dang*/ e sa bh+yo zlog hūm̐/ (139)shwa na mu kha'i dus la bab/ nam ni srod kyi dam can ma/ lcags kyi spyang mo mgo dgu ma/ mig dgu snying dgu 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ 'dra min snang mchan/ kha gdangs mig bgrad 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ rkan sgra 'brug sgra chems se chem/ mche ba gangs ri bsnol 'dra yis/ byad ma'i sha khrag rngam zas byed/ de la lcags kyi mi mos zhon/ lcags kyi ral pa sha ra ra/ spyan nas glog gi me 'od 'phro/ khrag gi char pa dmar po 'bebs/ spyang gdong dmar nag dgra (140)la rngam/ phyag na lcags phur dgra la brdeg byad gdon g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phyir/ sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ ban bon gdug pa'i sems ldan pa'i/ 'byung ba'i rgya la las bcol bas/ sa la sdebs gshor gnan gtad zlog rlan gsher klu la gtad pa zlog me la sbyin sreg btab pa zlog rlung la 'khor lo bskor ba zlog byad ma sod la byad thag chod/ byad rgya shig la byad phur phyungs/

thun khang shig la tha ram khrol/ (141)ban bon bsam sbyor log pa yi/ phra men gdug pa'i ngan sngags zlog zlog bsgyur drag po'i phrin las mjod/ bzhi snying dang*/ e sa bh+yo zlog bh+yo/ nam ni srod kyi dam can ma/ gser gyi 'phar ba lce brgyad ma/ ya 'gal nyi ma'i ngos la reg ma 'gal rgya mtsho'i steng la bzed/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad gnas su sgrol/ spu ni ral gri chu gri'i so/ bang ni rlung gi bskyod du med/ de la gser gyi mi mos zhon/ mche ba dmar (142)pos dgra snying za/ ral pa sprugs pa'i skra gsob nas/ sdom dang sdig pa char du 'bebs/ gser gyi phur pas dgra bgegs sgrol/ 'phar gdong ser nag dgra la rngam/ byad gdon g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phyir/ sha khrag gtor ma sogs 'gres so/ bzhi snying dang*/ e sa bh+yo zlog bh+yo/ nam ni srod kyi pho nya mo/ zangs kyi wa mo rkang gsum ma/ dpag tshad brgyad khrir khrag dri snom/ gzugs ni me yi phung po la/ mjug ma lcags kyi sog le can/ (143)mig ni nyi ma'i zer bas 'tsher/ spru ni spru gri'i po dang 'dra/ sder mo lcags kyu me stag 'phro/ bang ni rlung gi bskyod du med/ skad ni stong gsum khyab par sgrogs/ de la zangs kyi mi mos chibs/ sku las me yi phung po 'bar/ zhal nas khro chu'i me mda' 'phen/ g.yas pas rdo rjes ri rab bsnyil/ g.yon pas zangs kyi phur pa 'dril/ wa gdong dmar nag dgra la rngam/ byad gdon g.yul ngo

sogs 'gres so/ bzhi snying dang*/ e sa bh+yo zlog (144)hūm̐/ nam ni srod kyi pho nya mo/ lcags kyi khyi mo ral pa can/ mthing nag ral pas gnam pa gang*/ dus pa'i mchi ma ser chen 'grom/ zug pa'i skad kyis lha srin brgyal/ mche bas ri rab dum bur gtub/ lce yi rgya mtsho hub kyis 'debs/ de la zhon pa'i pho nya mo/ mthing gi mi mo ral pa can/ mun pa'i go zur sku la gsol/ bdud kyi dmag dpung bran du khol/ kha rlangs sprin du 'khrigs pa las/ rkan sgra brdabs (145)pas thog stong 'bebs/ mthing gi phur bus dgra bgegs sgrol/ khyi gdong dmar nag dgra la rngam/ byad gdon sogs 'gres so/ bzhi snying dang*/ e sa bh+yo zlog hūm̐/ bdag nyid chen mo'i dus la bab/ nam ni gung gi dam can ma/ dpal ldan lha mo re ma tī/ ri rab chen po'i rtse mo nas/ gling bzhi skyong bar byed pa'i tshe/ gling bzhi kun 'byams drag mo rgyal/ rgya mtsho'i gting na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ sring mo bha ga hri (146)ti ma/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dpal mo btsan/ mu le lding gi mtsho bdag mo/ ming brgya ma la mtshan stong ma/ dre'u rta skang gsum chibs su bcibs/ phyag g.yas me long sbrul zhags thogs/ g.yon pa kha ṭ+wām̐ phur pa 'jin/ 'du ba rnam bzhi'i nang bdag mo/ byad gdon sogs 'gres so/ bzhi snying dang*/ e sa bh+yo zlog hūm̐/ rak+ta'i mtsho la skur bzhengs pa/ nam ni gung gi dam can ma/ dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti/ dbang gi sku mdog dmar po (147)byad ma dam nyams glang snying can/ khug cig phob cig yan lag chings/ gzir cig khrag tu skyugs par gyis/ sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la/ ban bon rbod gtong sbyor ba yis/ gtad du bcug na gtad sprug cig byad du bcug na byad thag chod/ thun du bcug na thun khang shig khram la btab na khrab kha bzlog byad khang chom la byad ma sod/ byad thag chod la (148)byad rgya shig

byad kyi tha ram bkrol du gsol/ dus min 'chi rkyen ngan pa bzlog byad ma rang gshed rang la phob/ byad ma'i rang byad rang la bskor/ byad ma'i rang mthu rang la bzlog bzlog cig sgyur cig mthu ma chung*/ bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mjod/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya jaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ ka taṃ ka ye/ ja ye bhi ja ye/ a tsi te a pa ra tsi te/ ma ra so na pra marta na ye dgra bgegs sarba bhigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ e sa bh+yo zlog (149)byad gdon g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phyir/ sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ ban bon gdug pa'i sems ldan pas/ 'byung ba'i rgya la las bcol bas/ sa la sdeb gshor mnan gtad bzlog rlan gsher klu la gtad pa bzlog me la sbyin bsreg btab pa bzlog rlung la 'khor lo bskor ba bzlog byad ma sod la byad thag chod/ byad rgya shig la byad phur phyungs/ thun khung shig la tha ram khrol/ ban bon bsam sbyor (150)log pa yi/ phra men gdug pa'i ngan sngags bzlog bzlog bsgyur drag po'i phrin las mjod/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya jaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ ka taṃ ka ye/ ja ye bhi ja ye/ a tsi te/ a pa ra tsi te/ ma ra so na pra mar ta na ye dgra bgegs sarba bhigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ e sa bh+yo bzlog (151)la/ btso dmar la'u sku la gsol/ khrag skam lcags kyu phyur pa thogs/ chibs su bya rgyal khyung la bcibs/ bal nad le brgan nad bdag mo/ byad gdon sogs 'gres so/ bzhi snying dang*/ e sa bh+yo zlog hūm̐/ nam ni gung gi dam can ma/ dpal ldan lha mo re ma ja/ rgyas pa'i sku mdog ser nag la/ rma bya'i thul pa sku la gsol/ gcod byed gser gyi zer ba bsnams/ chibs su sha ba yu mo chibs/ ri rab rtse nas (152)las mjad ma/ mkhris pa sha yi nad bdag mo/ thog dang ser ba'i sna 'dren ma/ byad gdon sogs 'gres so/ bzhi snying dang*/ e sa bh+yo zlog hūm̐/ nam ni gung gi dam can ma/ dpal ldan lha mo re ma ju sku mdog ljang nag phrin las bdag

chu dar sngon po'i ber chen gsol/ phyag na khram bam phur pa bsnams/ rnga mong sngo nag chibs su bcibs/ pho log lhog rgod nang bdag mo/ kha ba bu yug sna 'dre ma/ byad gdon sogs 'gres so/ bzhi snying dang*/ e sa bh+yo zlog (153)hūm̐/ sa bdag chen mo'i dus la bab/ nam ni tho rangs dam can ma/ rgya gar bal po'i sa mtshams su/ chu mig byang chub bdud rtsi'i chu/ me tog dgun yang skyes pa'i sar/ tsha ba nad kyi bdag mo bzhi/ mthu stobs che bas so sor bzhag bal yul ya byin sa shed na/ mar khu'i mtsho mo mor ba na/ rdo rje ya byin dbang mo che/ sku mdog mthing nag 'bar ba la/ mthing gi ral pa sha ra ra/ mjes byed rma bya'i (154)thul ba gsol/ dbang gi bso khrab si li li/ spyi gtsug gser gyis rdo rjes brgyan/ rna ba slang tsam lhabs se lhab/ gser gyi rna cha wangs se wang*/ ral pa re zhing phur pa re/ phur pa'i lan phran khra la la/ ba spu re zhing lcags kyu re/ me lce dgu phreng sku yi rgyan/ dar nag cod pan pu ru ru/ chibs su g.yu 'brug sngon po chibs/ chibs kyi snga long phyi long la/ mi thod rta thod phru lu lu/ g.yas na bdud zhags nag po bsnams/ (155)g.yon pas lcags phur dgra la brdeg brda ni mi 'phrod lho bal skad/ gzugs ni mi ston lag brgya mo/ gsang ba'i bshugs pa kyu ru ru/ bal yul ya byin yul mdo na/ khrag mtsho mer ba'i nang shed na/ ya byin chen mo'i blon mo ni/ sa bdag chen mo ral gcig ma/ ral pa sprugs pas stong khams khyab/ nag mo spyan dmar mi bzad ma/ sa bdag 'bum gyi khad dpon mjad/ bal yul ya byin yul (156)phu na/ bdud kyi rgyal po rnam rol gnas/ jo mo ya byin mthu mo che/ blon mo nag mo 'khor bcas kyis/ nam phyed dus kyi mun pa la/ skad cig yud la yul phur byin/ bdud kyi rgyalalapo rnam rol bsgral de phyir bdud 'dul chen mor grags/ phur pa sgrub phyir gshegs su gsol/

byad gdon sogs 'gres so/ bzhi snying dang*/ e sa bh+yo zlog hūm̐/ sa bdag chen mo'i dus la bab/ nam ni tho rengs dam can ma/ yul ni tsha ba rong gi gnas/ de (157)byin bya ba'i sa shed na/ sbrang rtsi'i mtsho mo mer ba na/ sprul pa'i bse mkhar smug po na/ rdo rje de byin rtsal mo che/ sku mdog ser nar 'bar ba la/ gser gyi ral pa sha ra ra/ ral pa re zhing phur pa re/ phur pa'i lan phran khra la la/ spyi gtsugs gser gyi rdo rjes brgyan/ rna ba slang tsam lhabs se lhab/ dar nag cod pan pu ru ru/ gzi yi rna cha wangs se wang*/ ba spu re zhing lcags kyu re/ me lce dgra phreng (158)sku yi rgyan/ mjes byed rma bya'i thul pa gsol/ dbang gi bse khrab si li li/ chibs su gza' rta ser po bcibs/ gser zhags gser phur dgra la brdeg chibs kyi snga long phyi long la/ mi mgo rta mgo phru lu lu/ brda ni mi 'phrod lho bal mo/ skad ni mi go da ra'i skad/ gsang ba'i bshugs pa kyu ru ru/ gzugs ni mi ston lag brgya mo/ tsha ba rong gi de byin mo/ zhag mtsho sbrang rtsi mer ba'i nang*/ blon mo nag (159)mo klong dgu ma/ ye shes don rtogs gnyis med pas/ khrag gi thig le 'bum gyis brgyan/ sa bdag 'bum gyi khad dpon mjad/ de byin yul gyi phu shed na/ khrag mtsho mer ba'i nang shed na/ gza' rgyal mig dmar sprul pa gdongs/ jo mo de byin mthu mo che/ blon mo klong dgu 'khor bcas kyis/ nam phyed dus kyi mun pa la/ skad cig yud la yul phur phyin/ gza' rgyal mig dmar sprul pa bsgral/ (160)de phyir gza' 'dul chen mo bya/ sa bdag rgyal mo yal gam can/ phur pa sgrub phyir gshegs su gsol/ byad gdon sogs 'gres so/ bzhi snying dang*/ e sa bh+yo zlog bh+yo/ sa bdag chen mo'i dus la bab/ nam ni tho rangs dam can ma/ mang yul so byin steng shed na/ khrag zhag mtsho mo mer ba na/ sprul pa'i bswe mkhar smug po na/

rdo rje bswe byin 'phrul mo che/ sku mdog dmar nag 'bar ba la/ khrag gi ral pa sha ra ra*/ ral pa re zhing (161)phur pa re/ phur pa'i lan phran khra la la/ gser gyi rdo rjes thor tshugs brgyan/ rna ba slang tsam lhabs se lhab/ dngul gyi rna cha wangs se wang*/ dmar nag lce'u phran cod pan phur/ ba spu re zhing lcags kyu re/ me lce dgu phreng sku yi rgyan/ rma bya'i thul pa zha la la/ dbang gi bse khrab si li li/ bshugs pa'i brda skad di ri ri/ chibs su ri dwags bswe la chibs/ chibs kyi snga long phyi long la/ mi (162)mgo rta mgo phru lu lu/ btsan zhags seng phur dgra la brdeg brda ni mi 'phrod lho bal mo/ gzugs ni mi ston lag brgya mo/ mang yul de byin yul mdo na/ sa bdag nag mo dam tshig can/ lcags kyi spyang mo mgo dgu ma/ mtshan mo dur khrod khyab par rgyu/ stong gsum ma lus rjes kyis 'gongs/ gdug pa'i dgra la ngu zhing 'dra/ mche ba gnam lcags mtshon cha rno/ sa bdag 'bum gyi khad dpon (163)mjad/ de byin yul gyi phu shed na/ btsan brag ser rtsa'i nang shed na/ btsan gyi rgyal po zla ba gnas/ jo mo bswe byin mthu mo che/ blon mo spyang mo 'khor bcas kyis/ nam phyed dus kyis mun pa la/ skad cig yud kyis yul phur phyin/ btsan gyi rgyal po zla ba bsgral/ de phyir btsan 'dul chen mor bya/ sa bdag rgyal mo yal gam can/ phur pa sgrub phyir gshegs su gsol/ byad gdon (164) sogs 'gres so/ bzhi snying dang*/ e sa bh+yo zlog bh+yo/ sa bdag chen mo'i dus la bab/ nam ni tho rengs dam can ma/ snye nam 'gram gyi phu shed na/ 'o ma'i mtsho mo mer ba na/ sprul pa'i bswa mkhar smug po na/ rdo reja phag byin mthu mo che/ sku mdog dkar dmar 'bar ba la/ dung gi ral pa sha ra ra/ ral pa re zhing phur pa re/ phur pa'i lan phran khra la la/ rna ba slang tsam lhabs se lhab/ gser gyi rdo rjes thor tshugs brgyan/

(165)dar nag lce phran cod pan 'phur/ dung gi rna cha wangs se wang*/ ba spu re zhing lcags kyu re/ me lce dgu phreng sku yi rgyan/ rma bya'i thul pa zha la la/ dbang gi bswe khrab si li li/ chibs su chu rta sngon po bcibs/ chibs kyi snga long phyi long la/ mi mgo rta mgo phru lu lu/ g.yu zhags pa g.yu phur dgra la 'phen/ brda ni mi 'phrod lho bal mo/ gzugs ni mi ston lag brgya mo/ snye nam phag (166)byin yul mdo na/ mkha' la sprul pa'i g.yu mtsho na/ sprul pa'i bswe mkhar smug po na/ phag byin chen mo'i blon mo ni/ nag mo chen mo brang mig ma/ mgo med brang ni mig gis gang*/ brang gi 'og nas kha gdangs pas/ sdang ba'i dgra bo khyur mid byed/ stong khams sprul pa nag pos gang*/ sa bdag 'bum gyi khad dpon mjad/ snye nam phag gi phu shod na/ stong skyal bya ba'i yul phu na/ mtsho yi dam pa ma dros na/ (167)klu yi rgyal po deng po gnas/ jo mo phag byin mthu mo che/ blon mo brang mig 'khor bcas kyis/ nam phyed dus kyi mun pa la/ skad cig yud la yul phur byin/ klu yi rgyal po deng po bsgral/ de phyir klu 'dul chen mo bya/ sa bdag rgyal mo yal gam can/ phur pa sgrub phyir gshegs su gsol/ byad gdon sogs 'gres so/ bzhi snying dang*/ e sa bh+yo zlog jaḥ shar phyogs sgo nang dgra bgegs steng*/ dung gi skyes (168)bu gdug pa can/ sku mdog dkar po 'tsher ba la/ g.yas na shel gyi zangs yag bsnams/ g.yon pa shel gyi phur pa 'dril/ dgra bgegs snying la 'dril zhing 'debs/ chibs su seng ge dkar mo bcibs/ sku la spyang dkar slag pa gsol/ 'khor du ging chen tshogs kyis bskor/ dkar po 'bum gyi dmag dpon mjad/ khyed kyang phur pa'i srung ma ste/ byad gdon sogs 'gres so/ bzhi snying dang*/ e sa bh+yo zlog hūm̐/ lho phyogs sgo nang dgra (169)bgegs stong*/ lcags kyi skyes bu gdug pa can/

sku mdog sngo nag 'bar ba la/ g.yas na lcags kyi ral gri phyar/ g.yon pas lcags phur 'dril zhing 'debs/ chibs su lcags kyi spyang khu bcibs/ sku la dar nag ber chen gsol/ 'khor du bdud po'i tshogs kyis bskor/ nag po 'bum gyi dmag dpon mjad/ khyod kyang phur pa'i las mkhan te/ byad gdon sogs 'gres so/ bzhi snying dang*/ e sa bh+yo zlog baṃ (170)nub phyogs sgo nang dgra bgegs stong*/ bswe yi skyes bu gdug pa can/ sku mdog dmar nag 'bar ba la/ g.yas pas zangs kyi ra gri phyar/ g.yon pas zangs kyi phur pa 'dril/ chibs su bswe rta dmar po chibs/ sku la dbang gi bswe khrab gsol/ 'khor du bdud btsan tshogs kyis bskor/ dmar nag 'bum gyi dmag dpon mjad/ khyed kyang phur pa'i srung ma ste/ byad gdon sogs 'gres so/ bzhi snying dang*/ e sa bh+yo zlog hoḥ byang phyogs sgo (171)nang dgra bgegs steng*/ ḍāk+ki nag po rab 'jigs pa/ sku mdog ljang nag 'bar ba la/ g.yas pas gri gug dgra srog gcod/ g.yon pa bhan+dhar snying khrag 'thung*/ chibs su lcags spyang sngon po bcibs/ sku la lcags kyi go khrab gsol/ shan pa pho mo'i tshogs kyis bskor/ las mkhan 'bum gyi dmag dpan mjad/ khyod kyang phur pa'i srung ma ste/ byad gdon g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phyir/ sha khrag (172)gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ ban bon gdug pa'i sems ldan pas/ 'byung ba'i rgya la las bcol bas/ sa la sdeb gshor mnan gtad bzlog rlan gshor klu la gtad pa bzlog me la sbyin bsreg btab pa bzlog rlung la 'khor lo bskor ba bzlog byad ma sod la byad thag chod byad rgya shig la byad phur phyungs/ thun khung shig la tha ram khrol/ ban bon bsam sbyor log pa yi/ phra men gdug pa'i ngan sngags bzlog (173)bzlog bsgyur drag po'i phrin las mjod/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya jaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ ka taṃ ka ye/ ja ye bhi ja ye/ a tsi te a pa ra tsi te/

ma ra so na pra mar ta na ye dgra bgegs sarba bhigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ e sa bh+yo bzlog de nas thun gtor bsngo ba la/ zor bsgrub pa ni/ mu stegs dang*/ nang pa dang*/ sde brgyad kyi gnod pa dang*/ rbad 'dre rbod gtong dang*/ tha na gcan gzan gdug pa dang*/ sbrang bu yan chod kyi kha 'ching ba dang*/ bzlog pa'i spu gri 'di bzlas te/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī (174)la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ bdud pra mā ra ya rbad nan/ kha la ja ma li rbad nan/ ra tsa du ling shag rbad nan/ shig shig dum dum rbad nan/ tshal pa tshal pa rbad nan/ khroṃ khroṃ bh+yo bh+yo rbad nan/ rmugs rmugs rbad nan/ tir tir rbad nan/ tshal tshal rbad nan/ zhes bzla'o/ de nas/ hūm̐/ bar snang lha srin sde brgyad gson/ gnam sa bar gyi lha 'dre gson/ 'go ba'i lha lnga thams cad gson/ mchod sbyin gser skyems 'di bzhes (175)la/ gtor ma'i shul phye sku bzur cig dgra bgegs dpung gnyen ma mjad cig dam nyams dgra bgegs las ngan 'dis/ dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang smad/ rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i dam sri byas/ nam yang btang bar mi bya bar/ sa bdag chen mo'i dus la bab/ bdud kyi bu mo tsha ba'i rong nas bzhengs/ gza' yi bu mo bal yul mthil nas bzhengs/ btsan gyi bu mo mang yul gting (176)nas bzhengs/ klu yi bu mo snye nam phug nas bzhengs/ byad ma bsam sbyor ngan pa la/ khrag zer 'phang gi da tshur byon/ dgra bgegs gnas khyim bla srog la/ zor dmag drang ba'i dus la bab/ nad rims yugs kyi dmod mo yis/ dgra bgegs bla brog rlung la bskur/ gtor zor khrag zor dgra la bh+yo/ bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo/ zlog zlag zlog

snga ma'i thun sngags brjod la 'phang ngo*/ de nas chad mdo ni/ bh+yo/ sngon tshe bskal pa'i dang po la/ bcom ldan (177)karma he ru kas/ dregs pa'i sde dpon btul ba'i tshe/ ko seng dbang phyug nyer brgyad kyis/ srog snying phul nas dam la btags/ ji ltar zhal bzhes dam bcas bzhin/ bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mjod/ de rjes bar gyi bskal pa la/ a su ra yi brag phug tu/ grub pa'i slob dpon rnanam gsum gyis/ phur pa'i dngos grub brnyes pa'i tshe/ dregs pa can gyi (178)sde tshogs kyis/ srog snying phul nas dam la btags/ ji ltar zhal bzhes dam bcas bzhin/ bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mjod/ de rjes bskal pa tha ma la/ bal yul byang chub chu mig nas/ u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ phur pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe/ dam can ma mo bcu gnyis dang*/ ming po ging gi tshogs bcas kyis/ srog snying phul nas dam la btags/ ji ltar zhal (179)bzhes dam bcas bzhin/ bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mjod/ de nas snyigs ma'i bskal pa la/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal dang*/ rgyal yum spyod pa'i skyed tshal mas/ rgyal sras pad+ma las 'brel rtsal/ mngon sum rjes su bzung ba'i tshe/ srung ma dam can tshogs rnams kyis/ ji ltar zhal bzhes dam bcas bzhin/ bka' yi gtor ma 'di (180)bzhes la/ bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mjod/ de nas brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐/ dam la gnas pa brtan ma'i tshogs/ gnam gyi rgyal mo dpal 'bar ma/ gnam lha dkar mo yang dag shes/ kha rag khyung btsun dpal gyi yum/ kong btsun de mo bod khams skyong*/ gangs kyi yum chen g.yu bun ma/ 'brog gnas ma mo me stag ma/ 'brog gi rgyal mo za 'og ma/ byang gi rgyal mo zla 'od ma/ byang sman rgyal mo (181)gser thang la/ gangs dkar sha med kun tu bzang*/ sa bdag chen mo shīn+taṃ dpal/

klu yi bu mo gzi 'bar ma/ mi srun rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs can/ mjes pa'i sku la rin chen brgyan/ dar gyi lce'u mu tig dang*/ dril bu g.yer kha'i rgyan cha ldan/ sman phran 'bum gyi gtso mo mjad/ khros pas mi sdug gzugs 'chang zhing*/ gcan dang 'phro rgod zhi zhing rdzu/ bran g.yogs 'khor bcas gtor ma (182)longs/ bdag cag rig 'jin sgrub pa la/ dgra bgegs gegs dang zor kha longs/ mi mthun phyogs rnams ji snyed pa/ bzlog cing zhi bar mjad du gsol/ sa ma ya/ zhes pas mchod la nang du log nas/ gtor gzhong kha sbub ste/ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs/ zhe sdang rdo rje 'khor dang bcas/ 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams kun/ shin tu gdug pa'i sems can la/ zhe sdang chen po'i ting 'jin gyis/ skad cig nyid la (183)brlag mjad dam/ brlag par ma gyur gang yang med/ brlag mjad lha la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ma ra ya phaṭa/ bdag la sdang ba'i dgra gnod pa'i bgegs/ gdug pa'i dbal/ rno ba'i mtshon/ sbyor ba'i dug nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi/ gdon stong phrag brgyad cu la sogs pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad brlag par gyur cig de nas tshogs la rol pa ni/ hoḥ zhal zas tshogs kyi longs (184)spyod la/ bdag dang gzhan du mi dmigs pas/ mnyam pa'i dam tshig la gnas pas/ mnyam sbyor chen po'i dngos grub thob/ a la la hoḥ zhes blangs te phung khams kyi lha tshogs zag med bde bas tshim par rol lo/ de nas tshogs kyi lha ma byin gyis brlabs nas/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yis/ dbang bskur gsang ba'i mtshan btags pa/ lhag ma kha chu'i dam tshig can/ tshul bzhin mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa (185)gnyis po/ ye shes las las grub pa mo/ mkha' la thogs med 'gro ba med/ don la sangs rgyas yin maid kyang*/ sgrub pa po la phan gdags phyir/ bran gyi tshul du khas blangs pa/ sngon gyi thugs dam brtser dgongs nas/

lhag ma'i gtor ma bzhes su gsol/ ma hā amṛ ta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā ba ling+ta khā hī/ de nas dngos grub zhu ba ni/ hūm̐/ rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs dgongs/ sku (186)gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi/ byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ stobs kyis dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang*/ sku gsung thugs gsum dngos grub mchog dngos grub thams cad dus 'dir stsol/ tshe yi snying po rgyud gsum po/ srog gi snying po gzhal yas khang*/ skye shi med pa byang chub sems/ sku gsung thugs la rab tu thebs/ rtsa sngags dang*/ oṃ a yu pha la sid+dhi sid+dhi hūm̐/ a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ a we sha ya āḥ de nas (187) bzod par gsol ba ni/ hoḥ rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams/ thugs rjes bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ni so so'i skye bo la/ sems ni nyon mongs dbang gyur pas/ mi dge log pa'i bya ba dang*/ bag med bying rgod dbang gyur pas/ ting 'jin ma gsal rdzas ma tshang*/ brjed nges lhag chad gyur pa yis/ dngos grub bar chad gyur pa gang*/ bzod par bzhes nas tshangs par stsol/ yi ge brgya pa brjod do/ de nas (188) rtag chad kyi mtha' bsal ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha rnams hūm̐ gsum du gyur/ phaṭa gsum gyi de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ don gnyis byas nas hūm̐ gsum la thim/ gnyis po bdag nyid rtsa ba'i hūm̐ la thim/ de yang zhabs kyu nas nā da'i bar du thim/ nā da chos kyi dbyings su thim ste/ rang bzhin sems kyi chos nyid ni/ ma bcos lhug par gnas pa'i don/ rtag chad dngos po'i mtha' spangs shing*/ brjod bral mu bzhi (189)las 'das pa/ rtsol med gnas pa'i chos nyid de/ phur pa zhes ni de la bya/ zhes mi rtog par bzhag go rtsa sngags brjod pas/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i lhar ldang ngo*/ spyod pa rgyun gyi dam tshig bzhi bsrung ba ni/ gnyid kyi dgra gzhom/ myos 'gyur gyi chang sdom/ le lo'i dgra bsad/

gsang ba'i brda bsrung ba rnams tshul bzhin du nyams 'og tu chud par bya'o/ de nas bkra shis kyi me tog 'thor te/ hūm̐/ tshad med snying rje chen po yis/ srid pa phur bu sgrub pa yi/ srid gsum lha yi 'khor lo (190)dag rab 'byams rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog rdo rje lus kyi khams gsum po/ srog rtsol lam gyis gnad bsnun pas/ bde stong dga' bzhi'i ngo bor dag phyag rgya mchog gi bkra shis shog mā ra bsad pa'i da la ru/ mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa btab/ dgra bgegs rmag med rtsad nas dag bstan pa rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog chos dbyings spros dang bral ba la/ rig pa ye shes mnyam sbyor bas/ rdul (191)bral mkha' ltar rnam par dag 'bras bu mchog gi bkra shis shog 'di ltar snyan brgyad phur pa la/ 'phyong drug las dang sngags drug gis/ gdab pas phrin las tshang ba 'di/ mchog dbyangs sprul pa gter chen des/ bde skyong mi yi nor bu gsum/ dam tshig rdzas kyi ḍā ma ru/ rtsa ba'i phur sgrom dang bcas kyi/ maṇ+ḍal phul te gsol btab ngor/ phur pa lcam rgyal po lugs/ sna nam lugs dang jo mo'i lugs/ dbye bar grags pa mang na yang*/ mtsho rgyal thugs kyi brnag pa'i chos/ khyad par 'phags pa 'di kho na/ (192)zab 'dus tshang bar gnad du bsdus/ lag len gsal bar bgyis pa po/pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis bkod/ dge bas bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ byang chub sgrub la bar gcod pa'i/ bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam rgyal nas/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i go 'phang gi 'bras bu mchog la reg gyur cig ces pa'ang yang mi mchog sprul rin po che'i bka' bskul mang du gnang ba'i rkyen gyis smad las dug phur nag po'i phrin las byang bu 'di 'od gsal rin chen snying po pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis bris pa dge legs su gyur cig// /
